name: finance_monthly_close
label: Finance — monthly close
description: Internal monthly close pack run by the organisation's Finance & Treasury team. Captures budget vs actuals, revenue against target, accounts-payable health, and the basic month-end controls (bank reconciliation, audit findings).
notes: Submitted by the senior accountant after the monthly ledger close. Most values live on a monthly cadence; the audit-findings block reports quarterly because that's how often Internal Audit refreshes the registry.

values.name: budget_planned
values.label: Planned budget
values.description: Approved operating budget for the month, taken from the organisation's adopted budget book.
values.valueValidation: if(budget_planned < 0, 'Planned budget cannot be negative.', null)

values.name: budget_actual
values.label: Actual spend
values.description: What was actually spent during the month, after the ledger close.
values.valueValidation: if(budget_actual < 0, 'Actual spend cannot be negative.', null)

values.name: variance_explanation
values.label: Variance explanation
values.description: Short narrative explaining why actual spend deviated from plan. Only required when variance exceeds 10% in either direction.
values.enabledIf: budget_planned > 0 and (budget_actual > budget_planned * 1.1 or budget_actual < budget_planned * 0.9)
values.visibleIf: budget_planned > 0 and (budget_actual > budget_planned * 1.1 or budget_actual < budget_planned * 0.9)

values.name: revenue_collected
values.label: Revenue collected
values.description: Total income recognised during the month across fees, charges and grants.

values.name: revenue_target
values.label: Revenue target
values.description: Forecast revenue for the month from the adopted budget.
values.valueValidation: if(revenue_target < 0, 'Revenue target cannot be negative.', null)

values.name: invoices_paid_on_time_pct
values.label: Invoices paid on time
values.description: Percentage of supplier invoices paid within the agreed terms during the month.
values.valueValidation: if(invoices_paid_on_time_pct < 0 or invoices_paid_on_time_pct > 100, 'On-time rate must be a percentage between 0 and 100.', null)
values.warning: if(invoices_paid_on_time_pct < 90, 'On-time payment rate is below the 90% target — risk of supplier escalations.', null)

values.name: overdue_invoices_count
values.label: Overdue invoices
values.description: Number of supplier invoices still outstanding past their due date at month-end.
values.warning: if(overdue_invoices_count > 25, 'More than 25 invoices overdue — schedule a chasing run with AP.', null)

values.name: bank_reconciliation_complete
values.label: Bank reconciliation complete
values.description: Did the month-end bank reconciliation tie out without unresolved differences?

values.name: bank_reconciliation_notes
values.label: Reconciliation notes
values.description: What's outstanding on the reconciliation, and the plan to clear it. Shown only when the reconciliation didn't tie out.

values.name: open_audit_findings
values.label: Open audit findings
values.description: Internal-audit findings still open at the end of the quarter. Refreshed by Internal Audit and re-shared with Finance quarterly.
values.warning: if(open_audit_findings > 5, 'More than five open findings — escalate to the audit committee.', null)

layout.caption: Budget vs actuals
layout.description: Compare planned and actual spend. A variance explanation is requested automatically when the gap is more than 10%.

items.caption: Variance follow-up
items.description: Only appears when planned vs actual variance exceeds 10% in either direction.

layout.caption: Revenue
layout.description: Income recognised against the monthly forecast.

layout.caption: Accounts payable
layout.description: Supplier-side health: are we paying on time and how big is the overdue book?

layout.caption: Controls
layout.description: Month-end control checks. Reconciliation notes are required when the bank tie-out didn't balance.

items.caption: Reconciliation follow-up
items.description: Shown only when the bank reconciliation didn't tie out.

layout.caption: Assurance (quarterly)
layout.description: Audit registry status. Leave blank on monthly closes that don't end a quarter.
